name: Digital Service Squad member (Digital Main Street, Ontario)
summary: Paid squad roles helping Ontario main-street small businesses get online through free one-on-one support. Digital Main Street hires them in Toronto, and local BIAs or municipalities hire them when they have grant funding.
whatYouDo: You visit or contact the independent storefront businesses assigned to you, sometimes door to door with the local BIA coordinator, and help them with digital assessments, basic website setup, Google Business Profiles, social media and 360° photos. You also onboard them to the Digital Main Street platform and point eligible businesses to grants.
appeal: Paid, hands-on experience helping real small businesses go digital
Historically a large employer of students and recent graduates: over 1,600 hired by March 2021, per Ontario
Digital Main Street posted a 2026 squad-member role in Toronto
The skills carry over to freelance digital help for small businesses later
watchOuts: The 2026 Toronto posting's closing date (May 29, 2026) has passed, and no current opening was confirmed
Toronto roles require living in Toronto and travelling independently to businesses: hybrid, not fully remote
The 2026 posting describes pay only as 'competitive'; older roles were contracts (35 hrs/week in 2020)
Squads outside Toronto depend on Digital Service Squad grants. Brampton said in 2025 that the grant program's future was awaiting provincial updates, and its own squad contract ended June 30, 2025
Third-party grant listings that say the grant is 'open' are not official and may be out of date

training.notes: Squad members are described as trained specialists; training details were not seen.

compensation.notes: The 2026 posting offers 'competitive remuneration in line with industry standards', with no figure. A search summary attributed $15.50/hr to an old (about 2017) Digital Main Street posting; that figure is outdated and its exact source page is uncertain. Squad grants were reported to cover staff salaries and some equipment.

reliability.notes: Hiring depends on yearly program and grant funding. Roles are term contracts, not permanent jobs.

applicationSteps: Check Digital Main Street's careers page for a new squad posting
Ask your local BIA, municipality, chamber of commerce or Small Business Enterprise Centre whether it has Digital Service Squad funding this year
Prepare examples of helping a business with a website, Google Business Profile or social media
Confirm pay, contract length and work location before accepting
fitsIf: You live in Ontario (Toronto for Digital Main Street's own roles), like talking with shop owners and can explain basic digital tools.
notFitIf: You need fully remote work or a permanent position.
